subScenes.name: 偶遇打招呼
subScenes.description: 新搬来的居民在楼道遇见邻居，主动微笑问候开启对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, you're the new neighbor, right?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，你是新搬来的邻居吧？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻里偶遇，对方认出你是新搬来的并主动打招呼

followUps.text: Yes, I just moved in last week! I'm Alex.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我上周刚搬来！我是亚历克斯。

followUps.text: That's right! I'm a bit shy, but nice to meet you.
followUps.text_cn: 对，我是。我有点内向，但很高兴认识你。

followUps.text: Yep! By the way, do you know where the nearest grocery store is?
followUps.text_cn: 对！顺便问一下，最近的杂货店在哪？

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是邻里偶遇中最常见的开场白之一，回应时可根据性格选择热情、内敛或带问题的版本，自然推动对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: How’s it going with the move?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居关心你的搬家进展，表达友好

followUps.text: Pretty good! Just unpacking the kitchen now.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错！现在正在 unpack 厨房。

followUps.text: It’s been a mess, but I’m getting there.
followUps.text_cn: 乱成一团，但我在慢慢搞定。

followUps.text: Not bad! I’m still waiting for my furniture to arrive.
followUps.text_cn: 还行，就是家具还没到。

qaPairs.usageNote: 邻居常以关心搬家为切入点建立联系，回应时可选择乐观、真实或略带延迟的状态，避免过于负面或敷衍。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居注意到你养宠物并主动赞美，开启轻松对话

followUps.text: Thanks! He’s a rescue pup—his name’s Max.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！他是收养的，叫马克斯。

followUps.text: Yeah, he’s a handful—but I love him.
followUps.text_cn: 是啊，他挺闹腾的，但我超爱他。

followUps.text: Oh, you like dogs? I’m planning a neighborhood dog walk next weekend!
followUps.text_cn: 哦，你喜欢狗吗？我正计划下周末搞个社区遛狗活动！

qaPairs.usageNote: 赞美宠物是邻里社交的高成功率话题，回应可侧重情感表达、幽默或顺势建立社群联系，避免只说‘谢谢’而终止对话。

subScenes.name: 自我介绍
subScenes.description: 双方互相介绍姓名和搬来时间，表达友好态度。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hi, I'm new here — I just moved in next door. What's your name?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嗨，我是新搬来的，就住在隔壁。你叫什么名字？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居主动自我介绍并询问你的名字

followUps.text: I'm Alex — nice to meet you! I've lived here for three years.
followUps.text_cn: 我是Alex，很高兴认识你！我住这儿三年了。

followUps.text: Oh, hi. I'm Jamie. Just moved in last week — still getting used to the place.
followUps.text_cn: 哦，你好，我是Jamie，上周刚搬来，还在适应环境。

followUps.text: Jamie. And you? I'm still figuring out who's who around here.
followUps.text_cn: Jamie。那你呢？我还在搞清楚邻居们都是谁。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻里初次见面时的自然自我介绍回应，语气应轻松友好，避免过于正式或冷淡。

qaPairs.triggerText: I saw you walking your dog — are you the one who lives in the blue house?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我看到你遛狗了——你是住在蓝色房子里的那位吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居通过观察特征（如宠物、房屋）确认身份并开启对话

followUps.text: Yes, that's me! I have a golden retriever named Max. He loves the park down the street.
followUps.text_cn: 对，就是我！我有一只金毛叫Max，他超爱街尾的那个公园。

followUps.text: Yep, that's my place. I'm still learning the neighborhood — any tips on the best local spots?
followUps.text_cn: 没错，那就是我家。我还在熟悉社区，有什么推荐的好地方吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I'm in the green house — the one with the porch swing. I think we're next to each other!
followUps.text_cn: 其实我住在绿色房子里——就是有秋千的那个，我觉得我们是邻居！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当邻居通过非直接方式（如宠物、房屋）识别你时，回应需清晰、自然，可顺势展开话题。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, I'm Tina from 3B. We've seen each other around but never really talked — what do you do?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，我是3B的Tina，我们经常碰面但一直没聊过——你是做什么的？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居在多次碰面后主动开启更深入的自我介绍对话

followUps.text: I'm a graphic designer — work from home mostly. I'm always happy to chat when I'm not buried in deadlines!
followUps.text_cn: 我是平面设计师，主要在家办公。只要不是赶截止日期，我很乐意聊天！

followUps.text: I'm a teacher — elementary school. I'm usually out the door by 7 a.m., so we haven't crossed paths much.
followUps.text_cn: 我是小学老师，早上七点就出门了，所以一直没机会碰面。

followUps.text: I'm between jobs right now — just taking some time to reset. But I'm hoping to start something new soon.
followUps.text_cn: 我目前在换工作间隙，想休息调整一下，不过很快会开始新计划。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对话从表面寒暄转向职业等更私人话题时，回应应保持真诚但不过度暴露，符合邻里社交的分寸感。

subScenes.name: 询问设施
subScenes.description: 询问附近超市、垃圾投放点等生活便利信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you know if there's a laundry room in the building?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你知道楼里有洗衣房吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居询问小区公共设施

followUps.text: Yes, it's on the second floor next to the elevator. It's free for residents.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，在二楼电梯旁，居民免费使用。

followUps.text: I'm not sure, but I can check with the property manager for you.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，但我可以帮你问问物业。

followUps.text: Actually, I just use the laundromat down the street — it's cheaper and faster.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我用街角的自助洗衣店，更便宜也更快。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻里间自然询问公共设施，回应需体现友好与实用性

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a bike storage area around here?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这儿有自行车存放处吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居询问自行车存放设施

followUps.text: Yes, there's a covered rack right behind the main entrance. You need a keycard.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，主入口后面有个有遮盖的车架，需要门禁卡。

followUps.text: I don't think so — I leave mine outside, but I cover it with a rainproof tarp.
followUps.text_cn: 我觉得没有，我都是停在外面，但会盖防雨罩。

followUps.text: Wait, I think there's one in the basement — let me ask my roommate to confirm.
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我觉得地下室好像有一个，我问问室友确认一下。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应需体现邻里互助感，避免简单回答'不知道'或'没有'

qaPairs.triggerText: Have you used the community garden yet?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居询问社区共享空间使用情况

followUps.text: Yes! I grow tomatoes and basil — it's so relaxing. You can sign up next Monday.
followUps.text_cn: 用过！我种了番茄和罗勒，特别放松。下周一可以报名。

followUps.text: I haven't tried it — I'm not great with plants, but it looks lovely.
followUps.text_cn: 我还没试过，不太会种植物，但看起来真漂亮。

followUps.text: I signed up last year but gave up — the watering schedule was too strict.
followUps.text_cn: 我去年报了名但放弃了，浇水时间太死板了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应应反映真实生活体验，避免过度正面或敷衍，体现邻里真实互动

subScenes.name: 表达欢迎
subScenes.description: 邻居热情欢迎新住户，并提供生活小贴士。

qaPairs.triggerText: Welcome to the neighborhood! I'm Sam, I live right across the street.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 欢迎搬来！我是萨姆，就住在马路对面。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 新邻居搬来，老邻居主动表达欢迎

followUps.text: Thanks, Sam! I'm Alex — I just moved in yesterday. I'm really excited to be here!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，萨姆！我是亚历克斯，我昨天刚搬来，真的很高兴能住在这儿！

followUps.text: Oh, hi Sam! I'm Jamie. I appreciate the welcome — still getting settled, but I'm glad to be here.
followUps.text_cn: 哦，你好萨姆！我是杰米，谢谢你的欢迎——还在整理东西，但很高兴搬来了。

followUps.text: Wow, thanks! I'm Taylor. I hope I won't be too noisy — I'm still figuring out the place.
followUps.text_cn: 哇，谢谢！我是泰勒，希望我不会太吵——我还在熟悉这个家。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于新邻居初次见面时，回应对方的热情欢迎，体现自然社交反应

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, welcome! I saw your boxes — need any help carrying stuff in?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，欢迎！我看到你的箱子了——需要帮忙搬东西吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居主动提出帮助搬运行李，表达欢迎

followUps.text: That's so kind of you! I could really use a hand with this heavy bookshelf.
followUps.text_cn: 你太好了！我确实需要帮忙搬这个沉重的书架。

followUps.text: Thanks for offering — I'm good for now, but I'll definitely take you up on it if I get stuck!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你的好意，我现在还好，但如果卡住了一定会找你帮忙！

followUps.text: Actually, my friend’s coming in 20 minutes — but maybe we can grab coffee later to say thanks?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我朋友20分钟后就到，不过我们之后可以喝杯咖啡，当面谢谢你？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当邻居主动提供帮助时，用户可根据自身情况选择接受、婉拒或转化关系

qaPairs.triggerText: Welcome! I’m Linda from 3B. We’re having a little potluck next Saturday — you should come!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 欢迎！我是3B的琳达，下周六我们有个小聚餐，你一定要来！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居邀请参加社区聚会，表达欢迎与融入意图

followUps.text: That sounds amazing! I’d love to come — what should I bring?
followUps.text_cn: 听起来太棒了！我一定来——我该带点什么？

followUps.text: Oh, that’s so nice of you — I’d love to, but I’m out of town that weekend. Can I join next time?
followUps.text_cn: 你太贴心了！我很想参加，但那周末我外出。下次我能参加吗？

followUps.text: I’m still getting used to things here… but thanks for inviting me. I’ll think about it!
followUps.text_cn: 我还在适应这里……谢谢你邀请我，我会考虑的！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应邻居的社交邀请，体现不同社交舒适度和参与意愿

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 双方友好道别，约定下次再见，结束对话。

qaPairs.triggerText: Well, I should head out now.
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居礼貌告知即将离开，学习者需得体回应

followUps.text: Thanks for the chat! Take care!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢聊天！保重！

followUps.text: Oh, okay! Let’s catch up again soon.
followUps.text_cn: 哦，好的！我们尽快再聚吧。

followUps.text: Sure, I’ll walk you to the door.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，我送你到门口。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于邻居主动告别时的自然回应，语气应温暖但不夸张，符合日常邻里互动节奏

qaPairs.triggerText: I’ve got to run — got a meeting in 10.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我得走了，10分钟后有个会。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居因时间紧迫匆忙告别，学习者需快速得体回应

followUps.text: No problem — go ahead, and good luck with your meeting!
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，快去吧，祝你会议顺利！

followUps.text: Oh, same here — I’m late too!
followUps.text_cn: 哦，我也是，我也快迟到了！

followUps.text: Alright, see you tomorrow at the mailbox?
followUps.text_cn: 好的，明天邮箱边见？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于对方因时间紧张告别的场景，回应需简洁、有同理心，避免冗长

qaPairs.triggerText: It was nice catching up — I’ll let you get back to your evening.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 很高兴聊了这么多，不打扰你过晚上了。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 邻居体贴地结束对话，为学习者留出空间，学习者需礼貌回应

followUps.text: Thanks for stopping by — you’re always welcome!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你过来串门，随时欢迎你来！

followUps.text: Same here — let me know if you need help with your garden next week!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！下周如果你需要帮忙打理花园，记得告诉我！

followUps.text: Absolutely — have a lovely evening!
followUps.text_cn: 当然，祝你今晚愉快！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方表现出体贴和尊重时，回应应体现同等礼貌与温度，避免冷淡或过度热情
